name: Pad Ports
subtitle: Audited iPhone and iPad game ports
description: Audited iPhone and iPad apps linked from project-owned releases; import or build your own game data where the project requires it.

apps.name: DuskLight
apps.subtitle: Twilight Princess rebuilt for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A reverse-engineered GameCube engine with an iOS arm64 build backed by Metal. Supply your own authorized supported disc image inside the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Official DuskLight v2.0.3 iOS arm64 release. Its 77-entry IPA includes the cosmetics, Luau, and randomizer mods plus eight .bti texture resources; provenance of those texture resources is not established by the package audit.
Official upstream DuskLight v1.4.1 iOS arm64 release. No recognized game-image files were found in the audited artifact.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Dusklight allows network-enabled mods to connect to devices on your local network.

apps.name: RAtouch
apps.subtitle: Command and Conquer: Red Alert for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: The original Red Alert simulation with a native touch command deck. The IPA contains no commercial game data; supply authorized files after installation.

versions.localizedDescription: Project-owned RAtouch v0.1.0 unsigned arm64 IPA, audited as an iPhoneOS build with no recognized game-data files.
